name: @sveltex/sveltekit
description: SvelteKit adapter for the SvelteX application framework

scripts.test: pnpm --filter @sveltex/core build && npm run build && node --test
scripts.test:unit: pnpm --filter @sveltex/core build && npm run build && node --test tests/unit/*.test.mjs
scripts.test:security: pnpm --filter @sveltex/core build && npm run build && node --test tests/security/*.test.mjs
scripts.test:stress: pnpm --filter @sveltex/core build && npm run build && node --test tests/stress/*.test.mjs
scripts.test:lifecycle: pnpm --filter @sveltex/core build && npm run build && node --test tests/lifecycle/*.test.mjs
